title: Open Mic @ PAve
event_description: Weekly open mic night for musicians and performers. Bring your talent and share your music in a welcoming downtown atmosphere. All genres and skill levels welcome.
venue_address: 130 S Phillips Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104
event_venue_information:
About PAve

PAve is one of Downtown Sioux Falls' premier nightlife destinations featuring multiple levels and distinct atmospheres. The first floor Factory Avenue offers a contemporary industrial steampunk vibe perfect for relaxing while the second floor Roxbury Avenue features live entertainment and an outdoor patio.

Music and Events

The venue regularly hosts open mic nights live music performances and special events. With an extensive beer wine and creative craft cocktail list PAve has become a favorite local destination for both dining and nightlife.

Venue Features

Three different bars across multiple levels provide varied experiences for different crowds. The venue offers a full kitchen with unique food offerings alongside its beverage program. Half-priced drink specials on Thursdays are particularly popular among regulars.

title: Open Mic @ Wiley's Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic night welcoming singers musicians comedians and poets. A historic downtown venue with a supportive atmosphere and full technical support for performers.
venue_address: 330 N Main Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104
backline: Guitar and keyboard cables PA system Shure SM58 microphone Bluetooth connectivity Music stands
event_venue_information:
About Wiley's Tavern

A historic downtown Sioux Falls establishment that has been the community's go-to spot for fresh food favorite drinks and great times. The venue combines classic bar atmosphere with modern entertainment offerings.

Music Programming

Tuesday nights feature open mic opportunities starting at 8 PM welcoming all types of performers. Thursday nights showcase live music from local and regional bands covering rock country blues and acoustic styles. The venue provides comprehensive technical support including quarter-inch cables for guitars and keyboards DI boxes Bluetooth connectivity to the mixer and both wired and wireless microphones.

Additional Events

Wiley's hosts First Friday celebrations each month with themed events specialty drinks and DJs. The venue also features trivia nights sports viewing on over 30 HD TVs including the full NFL Sunday ticket and regular live music performances throughout the week.

title: Open Mic @ Corner Pub and Casino
event_description: Wednesday evening open mic session in a friendly neighborhood atmosphere. Musicians welcome to perform in this casual eastside venue.
event_venue_information:
About Corner Pub and Casino

A welcoming neighborhood establishment on Sioux Falls' east side known for its friendly staff and community spirit. The venue offers a relaxed atmosphere with reasonably priced drinks and engaging entertainment.

Entertainment

Wednesday nights feature open mic opportunities for local musicians and performers. The venue also hosts live music events on weekends and offers games including darts and karaoke on Saturday nights providing multiple entertainment options throughout the week.

Atmosphere

The pub maintains a casual inviting environment with plenty of seating options and multiple TVs for sports viewing. While primarily focused on beverages the venue occasionally offers pizza and other light food options.

title: Live Music - The Heinous 3 @ DaDa Gastropub
event_description: Weekly live music featuring house band The Heinous 3. Free show with full dinner and beverage service available. Experience live music in a unique gastropub setting.
venue_address: 402 N Main Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104
event_venue_information:
About DaDa Gastropub

A creative full-service restaurant and cocktail bar located within ICON Events in historic downtown Sioux Falls. The building was once a John Deere factory and now features eclectic artwork and decor that celebrates the Dadaist art movement.

Music and Entertainment

Tuesday nights feature live music from house band The Heinous 3 from 8-10 PM with free admission and full dinner service until 10 PM. The venue regularly welcomes live music into the space and occasionally closes the dining room early to accommodate touring acts. DaDa is located near Falls Park and the Levitt Bandshell.

Dining Experience

The gastropub specializes in unique cuisine options sourcing sustainable and local products. The menu is ever-changing to accommodate seasonal availability. A beautiful covered patio features functional original garage doors that open into the dining room creating an intimate indoor-outdoor atmosphere.

Hours and Atmosphere

Open Tuesday through Saturday starting at 5 PM. The venue offers expertly-crafted cocktails from a full bar alongside thoughtful cuisine. Sister business to Sioux Falls' beloved Parker's Bistro DaDa brings creative twists to both dining and drinking experiences.

title: Open Mic Night @ Full Circle Book Co-op
event_description: Sunday evening open mic welcoming musicians poets comedians and all creative performers. Inclusive community space with beer wine and coffee. Poetry-focused but all arts welcome.
event_venue_information:
About Full Circle Book Co-op

An inclusive independent bookstore beer and wine bar and event space in downtown Sioux Falls. This cultural hub merges the pleasures of reading with a welcoming community atmosphere providing a safe space for people of all ages to hang out discuss create and enjoy.

Events and Community

Sunday nights feature open mic events welcoming musicians poets and performers of all kinds. The venue regularly hosts live podcasts poetry readings book clubs and various community gatherings. Non-profit poetry open mics help raise funds for local organizations. The space is notably LGBTQ-friendly and promotes progressive ideals through education creative writing poetry and the arts.

Books and Atmosphere

The co-op boasts a vast collection of new and used books including rare finds and signed editions. Featured works include extensive selections from local and regional authors. The warm friendly staff and cozy environment make it a popular gathering spot. A bar serves beer wine coffee tea and non-alcoholic beverages allowing guests to enjoy drinks while browsing or attending events.

Mission

Full Circle believes in helping and strengthening the creative and progressive community in Sioux Falls. The venue features work from local artists in vendor booths and donates books to local shelters and prisons. Regular events and affordable prices ensure the space remains accessible to all.
